declarations.name: GraphClient

members.name: applies
members.doc: What of a spec or a task the platform cannot do yet, limits, or was never run for real (the capabilities rows whose trigger words the text writes), one line each: `title — summary (`id`, because it sa

members.name: brief
members.doc: A row in one line: `title — summary (`id`)`; "" when there is no such row.

members.name: card
members.doc: One row of the knowledge base by its id (`error:N0114`, `kind:backend.usecase`), with a line for each row it links to (`related`); "" when there is no such row.

members.name: examples
members.doc: Validated Nuclear closest to `task`: files of the example projects (`type = "file"`), solved tasks (`type = "solved"`) or both; `kind` keeps one kind (usecase, repository...).

members.name: items
members.doc: The cards that answer a query. `shelves`: one shelf or several separated by commas ("" = every shelf of the knowledge base). `kind` and `type` filter by those fields of a row; `kinds` keeps the rows t

members.name: kinds
members.doc: Every way a kind of the platform is written, in lower case, and the kind it means: `use case` → `usecase`, `application component` → `appcomponent`, `usecase` → `usecase`.

members.name: pitfalls
members.doc: The mistakes small models repeat with a kind, all of them: the `full` closest to the task as whole cards (the right shape to copy), the others in one line each (the rule).

members.name: prompt
members.doc: The validated prompt of a use case (feature, refactor, bug, docs, diagram, test, security, piece).

members.name: remember
members.doc: Keeps a piece of knowledge about a project (`memory`) or a solved example (`examples`) for later.

members.name: search
members.doc: The closest pieces of knowledge, as one text for a prompt. A local agent searches with `agents = true` and its `platform`: Nuclear and Dragonfly only, nothing of a target language.

members.name: strategy
members.doc: The strategy of a request (which kind of request it is, and the plan of that kind), each field a text: `id`, `title`, `summary`, `why` (the signs that chose it), `plan` (the card), `mode` (write, repa

declarations.doc: Reads and writes the Nuclear Smart Graph.

members.name: brief
members.doc: The short sheet: with a platform, Nuclear and the platform only (what a local agent reads); with a dialect, also the dialect and its language.

members.name: build
members.doc: The code a piece of Nuclear becomes (with a platform, in its default dialect's language).

members.name: check
members.doc: The errors of a piece of Nuclear (`ok` when it has none).

members.name: check_project
members.doc: The errors of every file of a project.

members.name: dragonfly
members.doc: A `dragonfly` command in a project (build, test, check, make, migrate...): its exit code and output.

members.name: help
members.doc: `nuclear help <word> [--platform p | --dialect d]`: a kind, decorator, topic or command.

members.name: layout
members.doc: Where each kind's file goes in a project of the platform (`nuclear help layout`): kind → path.

members.name: path_of
members.doc: The path of one declaration's file in a project of the platform ("" for an unknown kind).

declarations.name: Workspace

members.name: context
members.doc: The project's files that declare the names a task writes (`BookRepository`, `Book`), each as a ```nuclear block under its path: what a piece depends on. `skip`: the file being written.

members.name: declarations
members.doc: Every declaration of the project's `.nuc` files: its name → the file that declares it.

members.name: find
members.doc: The project's files that match a glob (`**/*_repository.nuc`), one path per line.

members.name: grep
members.doc: The lines that have a text (a regular expression) in the files of a glob: `path:line: text`.

members.name: list
members.doc: What a folder holds, one name per line (a folder ends with `/`).

members.name: outline
members.doc: The declarations of a `.nuc` file: each with its kind word, its name and its members' signatures.

members.name: read
members.doc: A file's lines, numbered, from `start`, at most `lines` of them.

members.name: renamed
members.doc: A rename done by a tool, not by a model: every `.nuc` file that writes one of the names the rename changes (`renames`) as a word, as its path → its whole text with the new names. Nothing is written: t

members.name: renames
members.doc: The names a rename changes: `old` itself and every declaration of the project whose name is built from it by putting words before or after (`NewBook`, `BookRepository`, `CreateBook` for `Book`), each

declarations.doc: The files of one project, for an agent.

declarations.name: as_text
declarations.doc: Search results as one text for a prompt: each card, then the rows it links to in a line each.

declarations.name: describe
declarations.doc: `line:col CODE message (fix: ...)`, one per error; `ok` when there are none.

declarations.name: diagnostics_of
declarations.doc: Every JSON array `nuclear check --json` printed (one per file group), joined; None if there is none.

declarations.name: layout_path
declarations.doc: The path of a declaration's file by the platform's layout; "" for a kind the layout does not know.

declarations.name: strip_fences
declarations.doc: The code inside a model's ```nuclear block (or the text as it is).

declarations.name: target
declarations.doc: `--platform backend` for a platform (what an agent that writes only Nuclear names), `--dialect fastapi` else.
